rules.question: Which paths does a record keep, and in what order?
rules.owner: store::prepare_record in src/store/record_store.cpp (the one walk of HydraRecord::all_paths)

exempt.why: The Paths tab lists every path of the analysis it shows (build_path_list); it keeps no record.
Declares HydraRecord::all_paths, the walk the owner reads.
Defines HydraRecord::all_paths, the walk the owner reads.

rules.note: The path report once walked each analysis itself to pick and rank its rows (report::chart_rows). Since D115 A2-2 it reads the rows the one save kept, so a page that walks an analysis's paths again could rank or cut them differently from the stored record. Decided by: D115 (spec section 5)
